spans.s:
लुल् r. 1st cl. (लोलति)
 1. To stir or agitate, to make tremulous.
 2. To
be attached to or connected with, to join.

लुलाप m. (-पः) A buffalo.
 E. लुल् to agitate, aff. क, stirring, shaking,
(in the mud,) आप् to get or obtain, aff. अण्; it is also read लुलाय ।

लुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Shaken, trembling, tremulous, agitated, stirred.
2. Heaving, panting.
 3. Agreeable, pleasing, beautiful, elegant.
 4.
Injured, destroyed.
 5. Coming in contact.
 E. लुल् to agitate, aff. क्तं.
